node.title: Re: Cwd::abs_path or FindBin::Bin?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[doc://FindBin] tries harder than [doc://$0] to resolve the path of the script, so I would always recommend the former.

The issue I have with this is: $FindBin::Bin will not resolve a symbolic link.

Sounds like you want $FindBin::RealBin instead.
